gates: Written intent before every provider call, receipt or error after. An unresolved intent stops the batch.
Reverse-rendering gate at prepare: undoing the declared renderings must reproduce the owner-locked written words exactly.
Guide tail energy below 0.02 (calibrate.TAIL_ENERGY_THRESHOLD) or the batch stops, no retry.
Exact-copy ASR gate per guide: hyperframes@0.8.59 whisper small.en, normalized token sequence equal to the bound spoken text.
narration-v1 is read-only for this run. Its receipts and media must not change; the aggregate counters read them.
failure_policy: Stop and report after any failed or uncertain provider outcome. No retry. Never transfer a guide that failed either gate.

why_a_rerun_can_differ: The Google stage is not seeded, so an identical request can return different audio. That is the whole basis for re-running it. The ElevenLabs stage is seeded (finding N4B-3), which is why a retry would be pointless there and why stage 2 is excluded here.
why_a_third_attempt_is_reasonable: Attempt 2 produced no audio at all. A 502 is a transient upstream failure, not a rejection of the request or a property of the script, so this is effectively the second real attempt at 03 rather than the third. The Google stage is not seeded, so the returned audio can differ.
